loadScene-sceneId.label: Scene
loadScene-sceneId.tip: Reset the scene container and load the scene with this ID

loadScene-transfer.label: Transfer Player
loadScene-transfer.tip: Whether to transfer the player actor after the scene is loaded

true.name: Yes
true.tip: Transfer the player actor to the specified location

false.name: No
false.tip: Does not transfer the player actor

loadScene-x.label: X
loadScene-x.tip: Move the player actor to this horizontal position

loadScene-y.label: Y
loadScene-y.tip: Move the player actor to this vertical position
